findings.title: order() mixin off-by-one for legacy box-ordinal-group
findings.body: The order() mixin copies $val directly to -webkit-box-ordinal-group and -moz-box-ordinal-group, but the legacy box model is 1-indexed while modern order is 0-indexed (correct mapping is box-ordinal-group = order + 1). As written, @include order(2) in extra-info-wrapper and @include order(3) in the header panel produce groups 2/3 in old WebKit/Firefox instead of 3/4, so ordering is wrong where those prefixes apply. Fix by emitting ($val + 1) for the box-ordinal-group properties.

findings.title: align-items mixin emits non-existent -ms-align-items property
findings.body: The align-items mixin outputs -ms-align-items, which was never implemented in any browser; IE10/11 use -ms-flex-align for this purpose. The declaration is dead code that bloats every call site using align-items(center/baseline) and signals a typo. It should be removed, leaving -ms-flex-align plus the standard align-items.

findings.title: float:right on .small-action button ignored inside flex container
findings.body: .small-action was changed to display:flex via flexbox(), making its direct children (avatar, description, button) flex items. Per the Flexbox spec float and clear on flex items compute to none, so the button's float:right no longer pushes it to the right edge; it will render inline right after the description text. This breaks small-action rows that expect a right-aligned button. Replace the float with margin-left:auto or justify-content:space-between.

findings.title: margin-left:auto replacement for float:right breaks legacy/non-flex browsers
findings.body: .d-header .panel lost its float:right fallback and now relies on margin-left:auto inside a flex container to sit on the right. The flexbox() mixin also emits display:-webkit-box/-moz-box, where auto margins are ignored, and browsers with no flex support get no positioning at all, so the panel will stay left or stack and overlap the logo/title. Keep a float:right fallback before the flex rules or add an explicit legacy packing fallback.
